data.one_liner: Customizable progress indicators with gradient and colorful circular designs
data.what_it_does: Provides a gradient linear progress bar and a colorful circular progress indicator for Flutter applications. Both widgets allow customizing colors, stroke widths, radii, and progress values.
use_when: You need a linear progress bar with a custom color gradient
You need a multi-colored circular progress indicator
avoid_when: You only want standard platform default progress indicators without gradients
strengths: Includes both circular and linear progress indicator options
weaknesses: Limited to specific progress indicator styles
Minimal options beyond basic styling parameters
